trigger: EventsLost increments between collect-start and the loss query (reads can run to the 10 s deadline) while a notify-driven candidate's window ends in that span and exactly one same-signature bystander event exists

ADAPTED, fixed in 125170317: a stamp (qnow) is taken immediately after session_loss() and the epoch is {last_query_ts_, qnow}. last_query_ts_ stays the tick's start stamp: setting it to qnow failed the existing 'loss over a held window degrades it' test in all three modes (Kernel, DecodeFailed, FailedQuery) because the next epoch must overlap these reads; the overlap is strictly more conservative and still closes the hole. Regression test added with a positive control and a no-loss control; mutation-verified (epoch end reverted to now fails REQUIRE(cur.loss.size()==1), then restored and rebuilt green). Epistemic status raised to verified by the mutation run.
